description: Probability (0 to 1) that picking the best of several backtested variants was overfitting, by CSCV over every variant's returns. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

matrix.description: Returns as fractions: one row per period, one column per variant.

n_splits.description: Even number of blocks, at least 2; default 16.

name: validate_overfitting
title: Validate overfitting (CSCV)
